briefs.explicit:
MISSION BRIEF M-011
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Time starts at t = 0 when every robot leaves its start location.

Locations (x, y, zone):
- base: (0, 0), outdoor
- office roof: (109, 80), roof
- north roof: (-45, -130), roof
- pump house: (98, -111), indoor
- storage hall: (121, -32), indoor
- transformer pad: (37, -74), outdoor
- gate 2: (-24, -110), outdoor
- parking lot: (-13, -62), outdoor

Robots:
- D1 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 9 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 1080 s, including the return to its start.
- G1 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 2 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 24 kg), camera. Endurance: 5220 s, including the return to its start.
- M1 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 6 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 3180 s, including the return to its start.
- M2 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 9 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2940 s, including the return to its start.
- D2 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 7.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg), thermal camera. Endurance: 900 s, including the return to its start.

Tasks:
- T1: Replace the filter cartridge at storage hall. Location: storage hall. Duration: 300 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T2: Collect a soil sample (1 kg) at parking lot and keep it on board. Location: parking lot. Duration: 120 s. Needs: robotic arm, cargo carrier (payload 1 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 360 s.
- T3: Photograph parking lot for the condition report. Location: parking lot. Duration: 120 s. Needs: camera.
- T4: Tighten the valve at parking lot. Location: parking lot. Duration: 120 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T5: Tighten the valve at storage hall. Location: storage hall. Duration: 240 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T6: Deliver the first-aid kit (12 kg) to storage hall. Location: storage hall. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 12 kg).
- T7: Deliver the toolkit (8 kg) to gate 2. Location: gate 2. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 8 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 240 s.
- T8: Inspect north roof with a camera. Location: north roof. Duration: 180 s. Needs: camera.
- T9: Deliver the first-aid kit (14 kg) to storage hall. Location: storage hall. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 14 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 300 s.
- T10: Deliver the sensor box (9 kg) to gate 2. Location: gate 2. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 9 kg).

Rules:
1. Every task is done by exactly one robot. A robot does its tasks one at a time, in the order you list them, travelling between task locations.
2. A robot can only do a task if it has the needed equipment, enough payload capacity, and can reach the task location.
3. A task that must start after another task waits until that task is finished, even if a different robot does it.
4. Each robot must be back at its start location before its endurance runs out.
5. Keep at least 1 quadcopter on standby: it must not be given any task.
6. Every task must be finished by t = 1200 s.

Objective: minimise the finish time of the last task (the makespan).
briefs.informal:
Here's what we need from the robots today.

Positions are in metres from the base at (0, 0). Drones fly straight and can't go indoors; ground robots follow the road grid (so they travel |dx| + |dy|) and can't get onto roofs. Everyone leaves their start spot at time zero.

Places: office roof (109, 80, a rooftop); north roof (-45, -130, a rooftop); pump house (98, -111, indoors); storage hall (121, -32, indoors); transformer pad (37, -74, outside); gate 2 (-24, -110, outside); parking lot (-13, -62, outside).

The fleet: D1, a quadcopter waiting at base, carries a camera and a thermal camera, cruises at 9 m/s, lifts up to 2 kg and has 18 minutes of flight time, return trip included. G1 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 24 kg at 2 m/s and runs for 87 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera. M1 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 6 kg, moves at 1.5 m/s and lasts 53 minutes including getting back. M2 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 9 kg, moves at 1.5 m/s and lasts 49 minutes including getting back. D2, a quadcopter waiting at base, carries a camera and a thermal camera, cruises at 7.5 m/s, lifts up to 2 kg and has 15 minutes of flight time, return trip included.

Jobs:
(T1) Swap the filter cartridge at storage hall - that takes 5 minutes on site.
(T2) Pick up a soil sample at parking lot and keep it on board; it weighs 1 kg - that takes 2 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 6 minutes.
(T3) Grab photos of parking lot for the condition report - that takes 2 minutes on site.
(T4) The valve at parking lot needs tightening - that takes 2 minutes on site.
(T5) Someone has to tighten the valve at storage hall - that takes 4 minutes on site.
(T6) Get the first-aid kit (12 kg) over to storage hall - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T7) Get the toolkit (8 kg) over to gate 2 - that takes 0.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 4 minutes.
(T8) Have a look at north roof - that takes 3 minutes on site.
(T9) Get the first-aid kit (14 kg) over to storage hall - that takes 0.5 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 5 minutes.
(T10) Get the sensor box (9 kg) over to gate 2 - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.

Keep one quadcopter on standby; don't give it any jobs. Everything has to be wrapped up within 20 minutes of the start, and the sooner the last job finishes, the better. Every robot has to make it back to where it started before its battery runs out.
